text:
maria: Hey IT team — got my ThinkPad X1 (Ubuntu 22.04). During company enrollment the Intune/Company Portal step failed, then after a reboot I'm dropping to initramfs asking for a LUKS passphrase I used for a personal disk. I didn't expect the device to be encrypted already. Can't get to desktop. Don't want to wipe /home. Can someone advise? @ben-it @it-help

ben-it: Hi Maria — can you share the machine serial (from BIOS) and confirm whether you set the LUKS passphrase before? Also, do you have an external drive to backup /home? Don't run any reformat commands yet.

maria: serial: SN1234567. Yes I used LUKS when I installed Ubuntu months ago (personal). No external backup with me. Can IT temporarily escalate admin so we can mount and backup to my USB at office?

sam-sre: Short plan: (1) boot a live USB (Ubuntu), (2) open LUKS:
```bash
sudo cryptsetup luksOpen /dev/nvme0n1p3 cryptroot
sudo mkdir -p /mnt/root
sudo mount /dev/mapper/cryptroot /mnt/root
sudo rsync -aAXv /mnt/root/home/ /media/usb-backup/home/
```
(3) After backup, we can run company-enroll tool:
```bash
sudo /usr/local/bin/company-enroll --reinit --preserve-home
```
Don't run `mkfs` or `cryptsetup luksFormat`. :warning:

ben-it: I'll grant a one-time temp admin (<1hr) and open a ticket. Please come by IT desk at 11:00 for in-person assist. Ticket INC-2026-082. Bring a 1TB USB formatted ext4.

kathy-security: Note: because you used a personal LUKS key we can't escrow the existing key. After backup we'll re-encrypt under company-managed TPM key. We'll create a recovery key and escrow to the vault: https://vault.redwood.example/recovery (sec access). Also keep any personal secrets off /home before we hand it over.

devices-bot: MDM enrollment assist scheduled by ben-it for 2026-03-24 11:00 — ticket INC-2026-082 created. :white_check_mark:

maria: Thanks all — on my way to office. Will bring USB. Appreciate the quick help! :pray:
